numericalMetadataMethod: Source character order paired with PDF Tj CID operands; CIDToGIDMap maps to numeric hmtx advance. Only advance integers retained; no font program or outlines redistributed.
rasterMethod: The rightmost pipe is matched exactly to the standalone pipe; subtract its original bearing. Repeat spans 2400 nominal font-width units (2100 for per-mille, or 2000 in its width200 confirmation, to avoid clipping).
